mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification (receiver_id, sender_id, type, target_type, target_id, article_id, content, is_read, dedup_key) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{articleId}, #{content}, 0, #{dedupKey})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
